instructions: Independently judge every statement against the cited local source in each language. Do not read keys, notes, patches or the bank. Return id, verdicts, tc_verdicts (T/F arrays), quotes (one deciding source excerpt per statement), doubts and tc_mismatch (empty strings when none). A language=en quote for doc24 is an English original supporting a clearly labelled Chinese study translation.

en.q: Regarding notices refusing a money service licence or changing its conditions, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: A refusal to grant a money service licence must be communicated to the applicant by a notice in writing.
A refusal to renew a money service licence must be communicated to the licensee by a notice in writing.
A notice refusing a grant must state both the reasons and the applicant’s right to apply for Tribunal review.
A notice changing licence conditions need state reasons only when the licensee asks the Commissioner for them.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於拒絕批給金錢服務牌照或更改牌照條件的通知，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 關長拒絕批給金錢服務牌照時，須以書面通知將決定告知有關申請人。
關長拒絕將金錢服務牌照續期時，須以書面通知將決定告知有關持牌人。
拒絕批給牌照的通知，須載有決定理由，以及申請人可向覆核審裁處申請的提示。
更改牌照條件的通知，只須在持牌人向關長要求提供理由時，才載列有關理由。

en.q: Regarding the particulars and conditions appearing on a money service licence, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: A licence for operation at specified premises must name the address of every premises where the licensee may operate.
A licence for operation without particular premises must specify the residential address of each of its directors.
The licence must be endorsed with conditions imposed or amended on grant, renewal or a later change of conditions.
The licence must use a form specified by the Commissioner and state the period for which the licence remains valid.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於金錢服務牌照載列的資料和條件，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 准予在指明處所經營的牌照，須指明持牌人可經營金錢服務的每一個處所的地址。
准予不在特定處所經營的牌照，須指明持牌人每一名董事現時居住的住宅地址。
牌照須批註根據批給、續期或其後修改牌照條件的條文而施加或修改的條件。
牌照須採用關長指明的格式，並且必須在牌照上指明牌照的有效期間。

en.q: Regarding refusing approval of a proposed director, ultimate owner or partner of a licensee, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: When approval of a proposed director is refused, the written refusal notice must be given to the licensee.
When approval of a proposed ultimate owner is refused, the notice must explain the reasons for that decision.
When approval of a proposed partner is refused, the notice must state that the licensee may seek Tribunal review.
When approval of a proposed director is refused, the notice must state that the proposed director may seek review.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於拒絕批准持牌人的擬任董事、最終擁有人或合夥人，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 關長拒絕批准擬任董事的申請時，必須以書面通知將決定告知有關持牌人。
關長拒絕批准擬任最終擁有人的申請時，通知必須載有作出該決定的理由。
關長拒絕批准擬任合夥人的申請時，通知須提示持牌人可向覆核審裁處申請覆核。
關長拒絕批准擬任董事的申請時，通知須提示擬任董事可向覆核審裁處申請覆核。

en.q: Regarding what a disciplinary decision notice must tell a licensee, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: The Commissioner must give the licensee a written notice informing it of the disciplinary decision that was made.
Where a reprimand is imposed, the notice must include the terms in which the licensee is reprimanded in the decision.
Where remedial action is ordered, the notice must include the action the licensee is required to take under the decision.
Where a longer payment period is allowed, the notice may omit the deadline so long as it specifies the penalty amount.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於紀律處分決定通知須告知持牌人的事項，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 關長作出紀律處分決定後，必須藉書面通知將有關決定告知有關持牌人。
如決定包括譴責，通知必須在適用範圍內，載有根據決定對持牌人的譴責內容。
如決定命令採取糾正行動，通知必須在適用範圍內，載列持牌人須採取的行動。
如准許較長繳款期，只要通知已列明罰款金額，便可不列明繳付罰款的時限。

en.q: Regarding enforcing and publishing money service disciplinary penalties, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: On the Commissioner’s application, the Court of First Instance may register an order to pay a daily pecuniary penalty.
To seek registration, the Commissioner must give the High Court Registrar a written request and the original and a copy.
On registration, the penalty order is treated as a money-payment order made within the court’s criminal jurisdiction.
After taking disciplinary action, the Commissioner may publicly disclose the decision, reasons and material case facts.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於執行及公布金錢服務紀律罰款，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 原訟法庭可應關長的申請，登記就持續沒有採取糾正行動而作出的按日罰款命令。
關長要求登記命令時，須向高等法院司法常務官送交書面要求、命令正本及一份複本。
罰款命令一經登記，即視為原訟法庭在其刑事司法管轄權範圍內作出的繳付款項命令。
關長採取紀律行動後，可向公眾披露決定的細節、決定理由及個案的任何重要事實。

en.q: Regarding an application to extend the time for seeking a review, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: Before granting an extension, the Tribunal must give both the applicant and the specified authority a chance to be heard.
To grant an extension, the Tribunal must be satisfied there is good cause for extending the time for the review application.
A person seeking an extension must await its determination before applying for a stay of the underlying specified decision.
In granting a stay, the Tribunal may attach conditions concerning costs or the payment of money into the Tribunal.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於申請延長提出覆核的期限，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 審裁處批准延長期限前，必須給予申請人及有關指明當局雙方合理的陳詞機會。
審裁處批准延長提出覆核的期限前，必須信納有良好因由批准延長有關期限。
申請延長期限的人，必須等候延長期限申請獲裁定後，才可申請暫緩執行指明決定。
審裁處批准暫緩執行時，可在訟費或繳存款項於審裁處方面，定出適當的條件。

en.q: Regarding the form and proof of Review Tribunal orders, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: An order made by the Tribunal must be recorded in writing and signed by the chairperson of the Tribunal.
A document appearing to be a Tribunal order signed by its chairperson is presumed valid even if contrary evidence exists.
Absent contrary evidence, such a signed document benefits from the presumption without separate proof of its making.
Even absent contrary evidence, the presumption needs separate proof that the signer actually held the chairperson’s office.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於覆核審裁處命令的格式及證明，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 審裁處在覆核中作出的命令必須以書面形式記錄，並且由覆核審裁處主席簽署。
文件看來是由主席簽署的審裁處命令，即使有相反證據，也須推定為妥為作出及簽署。
在沒有相反證據時，該類看來由主席簽署的文件，無需另行提出作出命令的證明。
即使沒有相反證據，該項推定仍須另外證明簽署命令的人確實是覆核審裁處主席。

en.q: Regarding the Review Tribunal’s control over evidence and procedure, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: The Tribunal can require attendance and production of relevant documents by written notice signed by the chairperson.
The Tribunal may examine a person attending before it, but questions can be required only if that person is under oath.
The Tribunal may order a witness to provide evidence for the purposes of the review by means of an affidavit.
The Tribunal may stay proceedings on grounds and terms it considers appropriate, having regard to the interests of justice.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於覆核審裁處對證據及程序的控制，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 審裁處可藉主席簽署的書面通知，要求某人出席聆訊及交出攸關覆核的文件。
審裁處可訊問到席的人，但只有在該人經宣誓的情況下，才可規定該人回答問題。
審裁處可為進行有關覆核的目的，命令證人以誓章的方式提供所需的證據。
審裁處可在顧及公正原則下，按其認為適當的理由及條款擱置覆核程序。

en.q: Regarding conduct by witnesses and others during a Tribunal review, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: A person required to attend may leave without permission once the person’s own evidence has been given.
Without reasonable excuse, deterring someone from producing documents for a review constitutes an offence.
Insulting a witness because of attending is an offence only if financial loss is also caused to the witness.
A person may refuse compliance solely because following the Tribunal’s requirement could incriminate that person.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於證人及其他人在審裁處覆核中的行為，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 被要求出席聆訊的人，在完成自己的證供後，即可不經審裁處准許而離開。
無合理辯解而阻嚇他人為覆核目的交出文件，屬於條例所訂的一項罪行。
因證人出席聆訊而侮辱證人，只有在同時令證人蒙受金錢損失時才屬犯罪。
任何人可僅因遵從審裁處的要求可能導致自己入罪，而拒絕遵從該項要求。

en.q: Regarding costs awarded to someone attending a Tribunal review, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: Someone whose attendance was necessary for the review may receive costs even without attending as a witness.
The Tribunal may award an appropriate sum for costs reasonably incurred in the review and its application.
Costs awarded to a necessary attendee must always be paid by the applicant who initiated the review.
Costs awarded to a necessary attendee are recoverable from the designated party as a criminal fine.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於判給出席審裁處覆核的人的訟費，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 為覆核而需要出席的人，即使並非以證人身分出席，也可獲審裁處判給訟費。
審裁處可就覆核及覆核申請而合理招致的訟費，判給其認為數額適當的款項。
判給有需要出席的人的訟費，必須一律由最初提出覆核申請的申請人支付。
判給有需要出席的人的訟費，可向被指定支付的覆核一方作為刑事罰款追討。

en.q: Regarding restrictions on publishing the outcome of a private Tribunal hearing, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: If any part of a review hearing was private, the Tribunal may prohibit publication of part of its determination.
The power to restrict publication also covers reasons for the determination, including only part of those reasons.
The Tribunal may also prohibit publication of a costs order or any part of the reasons for making that order.
After completing the review, the Tribunal must deliver any costs order and explain the reasons for that order.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於公布審裁處閉門聆訊結果的限制，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 只要覆核聆訊的任何部分閉門進行，審裁處便可禁止發表其裁定的任何部分。
限制發表的權力也涵蓋作出裁定的理由，包括只限制發表該等理由的某一部分。
審裁處也可禁止發表有關訟費命令，或禁止發表作出該訟費命令的部分理由。
完成覆核後，審裁處須盡快宣告就覆核作出的任何訟費命令，以及作出命令的理由。

en.q: Regarding parallel contempt and criminal proceedings for the same Tribunal misconduct, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: While an earlier prosecution for the same conduct under the Tribunal offence provision is pending, contempt action is barred.
A prior prosecution can bar contempt action even after it ends, if that prosecution prevents lawful prosecution again for that conduct.
Once contempt proceedings have begun, a prosecution for the same conduct may proceed alongside them until contempt is finally determined.
The prohibition on taking both routes also prevents prosecution for a completely different act of misconduct during the review.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於就同一審裁處不當行為並行進行藐視及刑事程序，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 就同一行為按審裁處罪行條文提出的較早刑事程序仍待決時，不得行使藐視懲罰權力。
較早刑事程序結束後，如因此不得就同一行為再次合法檢控，仍不得行使藐視懲罰權力。
按藐視法庭罪追究的程序待決時，可同時就同一行為檢控，直至該程序獲最終裁定。
不得並用兩種程序的規定，也禁止就覆核過程中另一項完全不同的不當行為提出刑事檢控。

en.q: Regarding changes in particulars, licence display and closure, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: The duty to report changed particulars also covers particulars already supplied through an earlier change notification.
After receiving a change notification, the Commissioner must update relevant register particulars where this is necessary.
A licensee returning its licence for cancellation after closure is entitled to a refund of the unused licence period.
Failing without reasonable excuse to display the original licence is punishable on conviction by a level 5 fine.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於詳情改變、展示牌照及停業，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 具報詳情改變的責任，也涵蓋持牌人先前在具報改變時已經提供予關長的詳情。
關長接獲具報改變後，須在有需要時，盡快修改登記冊內有關的詳情。
持牌人停業後將牌照交回以作取消，有權獲退還牌照尚未使用期間的牌照費。
無合理辯解而沒有展示牌照正本的持牌人，一經定罪，可處第5級罰款。

en.q: Regarding the mandatory preparation for exercising pecuniary penalty powers, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: Before first using the money service penalty power, the Commissioner must publish guidelines on how it will be used.
Those money service guidelines must be published in the Gazette as well as any other manner considered appropriate.
The Commissioner must have regard to the published guidelines when using the money service pecuniary penalty power.
For the separate financial-institution penalty power, the relevant authority likewise must publish guidelines before first use.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於行使施加罰款權力前的法定準備，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 關長首次使用金錢服務罰款權力前，必須公布指引，示明擬採用何種方式行使該權力。
上述金錢服務罰款指引必須在憲報刊登，並以關長認為適當的其他方式公布。
關長使用金錢服務罰款權力時，必須顧及按法定要求刊登及公布的罰款指引。
就另一項金融機構罰款權力而言，有關當局也必須在首次行使該權力前公布指引。

en.q: Regarding former politically exposed persons and ongoing monitoring, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: An MSO may cease the special PEP monitoring measures once it assesses a former PEP as not presenting a high ML/TF risk.
A customer’s retirement from public office alone permits the MSO to end the special PEP monitoring without a risk assessment.
The monitoring exception can apply where a corporate customer’s beneficial owner, rather than the customer, is the former PEP.
A current PEP assessed as low risk qualifies for the former-PEP monitoring exception without first leaving public office.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於前政治人物及持續監察，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 經適當評估信納前政治人物不造成高度洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集風險後，可停止政治人物特別監察。
客戶單憑已從重要公職退休，便可讓經營者在沒有風險評估下停止政治人物的特別監察措施。
監察例外也可用於法團客戶的實益擁有人屬前政治人物的情況，而不只限於客戶本人。
仍在任的重要公職人員只要獲評估為低風險，無須離任也符合前政治人物的監察例外。

en.q: Regarding which event starts the five-year record-retention period, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: For a completed occasional exchange requiring CDD, the customer-identification record clock starts when that exchange is completed.
For a completed occasional wire transfer requiring CDD, the customer record clock waits until the customer returns for another transfer.
If a transaction completes one year before the relationship ends, its transaction records still run from that transaction’s completion.
Customer-identification files in a continuing relationship may be discarded five years after the last transaction, despite the relationship continuing.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於五年紀錄保存期由甚麼事件起計，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 須作盡職審查的非經常兌換交易完成後，客戶身分紀錄的保存期從該項交易完成當日起計。
須作盡職審查的非經常電傳轉賬完成後，客戶紀錄的保存期須等客戶再次匯款才開始起計。
如交易在業務關係終止前一年完成，交易紀錄的保存期仍從該項交易完成之日開始起計。
持續業務關係中的客戶身分檔案，可在最後交易完成五年後刪除，即使業務關係仍在繼續。

en.q: Regarding using an agent or an intermediary to perform CDD, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: An MSO may appoint an agent to perform a CDD measure, but remains liable under the AMLO if that measure is not carried out.
Calling the service provider an agent instead of an intermediary transfers the statutory liability for failed CDD away from the MSO.
A specified intermediary’s verbal consent is enough if the MSO is satisfied that documents will be available promptly when requested.
A written intermediary appointment removes the MSO’s statutory liability if the intermediary later fails to perform the agreed CDD measure.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於藉代理人或中介人執行客戶盡職審查，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 經營者可藉代理人執行盡職審查措施，但沒有執行該措施時，仍須根據條例負有法律責任。
把服務提供者稱為代理人而非中介人，可把盡職審查失責的法定責任從經營者轉移出去。
如經營者信納文件可在要求時迅速提供，即使指明中介人只是口頭同意，也足以符合要求。
中介人書面接受委任後，如其未有執行約定的盡職審查措施，經營者便不再負法定責任。

en.q: Regarding an overseas branch blocked by local law from applying AML procedures, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: A Hong Kong-incorporated MSO must add effective risk-mitigation measures when local law blocks required procedures at an overseas branch.
Informing the relevant authority of the legal obstacle alone discharges the duty even if no additional risk mitigation is put in place.
The same additional-mitigation duty can apply to a covered overseas subsidiary undertaking, rather than only to an overseas branch.
The MSO must ensure comparable procedures to the extent local law permits, rather than treating one legal obstacle as a complete exemption.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於海外分行因當地法律而不能實行打擊洗錢程序，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 香港成立的經營者遇到海外法律阻止分行實行所需程序時，必須採取增補措施有效減低風險。
只要已把法律障礙通知有關當局，即使沒有增補風險減低措施，也已完全履行有關責任。
同一增補風險減低責任，也可適用於受規定涵蓋的海外附屬企業，並非只限於海外分行。
經營者須確保在當地法律准許的範圍內有相類程序，不可把一項法律障礙當作全面豁免。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條實益擁有人定義(c)段

en.q: Regarding identifying beneficial owners of a trust with vested future interests, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: A beneficiary entitled to a vested remainder interest may count even though the beneficiary does not presently possess the trust property.
A class of beneficiaries entitled to vested interests may count even though the definition refers to a class rather than a single beneficiary.
A beneficiary’s vested interest is excluded from the definition if the terms of the trust make that vested interest defeasible.
A vested reversion interest falls within the definition, so current possession is not the only form of interest that the MSO must consider.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於識別具有既得未來權益的信託實益擁有人，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 有權享有既得剩餘權益的受益人，即使現時未管有信託財產，也可屬實益擁有人。
有權享有既得權益的某類別受益人，即使是一個類別而非單一人士，也可屬實益擁有人。
受益人的既得權益，如按信託條款屬可予廢除的權益，便被排除於實益擁有人定義之外。
既得復歸權益也屬定義範圍，因此經營者不能只考慮目前具有管有權的信託權益。

en.q: Regarding the card-transaction exclusion from special wire-transfer requirements, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: A card-funded transfer to another individual fails the card exclusion where the card is used as a person-to-person payment system.
An ATM withdrawal using a debit card is one of the examples of card transactions identified for the exclusion.
A card purchase automatically qualifies for the exclusion even where the card number or equivalent identifier is absent from its message.
A cash advance on a credit card is outside the examples, because the exclusion lists purchases of goods and services only.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於卡交易不適用電傳轉賬特別規定的界線，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 如以卡作個人與個人之間的支付系統，向另一人轉款便不符合卡交易不適用規定的條件。
使用扣帳卡透過自動櫃員機從銀行戶口提款，是不適用規定列出的其中一項卡交易例子。
購物使用信用卡後，即使附隨信息沒有卡號或等同獨特識別編碼，也自動符合不適用規定。
信用卡現金貸款不在例子之列，因為不適用規定只列出購買貨物及服務的卡交易。

en.q: Regarding CDD triggered by changes to a pre-existing customer’s account, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: A material change in account operation triggers CDD even without an unusual transaction occurring at that same time.
A material change in account operation triggers CDD only after the MSO has also formed a money-laundering suspicion.
The special rules for pre-existing customers replace the separate CDD trigger for doubts about identification information.
If CDD triggered by the material change cannot be completed, keeping the relationship until the next annual review is allowed.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於先前客戶戶口轉變所觸發的盡職審查，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 戶口操作方式有重大轉變，即使當時沒有異乎尋常交易發生，也會觸發盡職審查。
戶口操作方式有重大轉變，只有在經營者也已形成洗錢懷疑後，才會觸發盡職審查。
先前客戶的特別規定，取代了對身分識別資料有疑問時另須執行盡職審查的責任。
如未能完成重大轉變所觸發的盡職審查，經營者可保留業務關係直至下次年度覆核。

en.q: Regarding different high-risk situations faced by an MSO, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: For a high-risk occasional transaction, the special rule requires additional measures to mitigate the ML/TF risk involved.
For a new high-risk relationship, extra mitigation can replace source-of-wealth and source-of-funds measures, but not senior approval.
For an existing high-risk relationship with a beneficial owner, identity verification of that owner may be replaced by additional mitigation.
For an existing high-risk relationship, mitigation measures remove the need for senior approval to continue the relationship.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於經營者面對的不同高風險情況，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 對高風險非經常交易，特別規定要求採取額外措施，減低所涉洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集風險。
對新高風險業務關係，額外措施可替代確立財富及資金來源的措施，但不能替代高級管理層批准。
對有實益擁有人的現有高風險業務關係，核實該擁有人身分的責任可由額外減低風險措施取代。
對現有高風險業務關係，只要採取減低風險措施，便無須高級管理層批准而可繼續該關係。

en.q: Regarding classifying a wire transfer whose route includes an overseas intermediary, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: A transfer between two Hong Kong institutions routed through an overseas intermediary fails the definition of a domestic wire transfer.
Such a transfer qualifies for the domestic reduced-message rule merely because its ordering and beneficiary institutions are both local.
If it receives this transfer as beneficiary without required information, an MSO must seek the missing information from the instructing institution.
An MSO acting as an intermediary on this non-domestic route must also address missing required information, rather than merely pass it on.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於將涉及海外中介機構的電傳轉賬分類，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 兩間香港機構之間的轉賬，如經海外中介機構處理，便不符合本地電傳轉賬的定義。
這類轉賬只因匯款及收款機構同在本地，便可使用本地轉賬的簡化附隨信息規則。
經營者以收款機構身分接收這類轉賬而欠缺所需資料時，須向發出指示的機構取得遺漏資料。
經營者在這類非本地路徑以中介機構身分行事，也須處理遺漏資料，不可只把轉賬傳遞下去。

en.q: Regarding the limits of using recognized digital identification for an absent customer, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: Using recognized digital identification to identify and verify an absent customer can disapply the special absence-related identification measures.
That digital identification can also remove the extra monitoring obligation arising solely from the customer’s absence for identification.
If the digitally verified customer is a current PEP, the MSO can also omit senior approval because digital verification replaces PEP measures.
Digital identification removes monitoring measures caused by a separate high-risk situation as well as measures caused by physical absence.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於對沒有現身客戶使用認可數碼識別的限制，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 用認可數碼識別系統識別及核實沒有現身的客戶，可令沒有現身所需的特別識別措施不適用。
該數碼識別也可令純粹因客戶沒有為識別而現身所產生的額外監察責任不適用。
如經數碼核實的客戶是在任政治人物，數碼核實也可取代政治人物措施，令高級管理層批准不必進行。
數碼識別既可取消因客戶沒有現身引起的監察措施，也可取消另一高風險情況所引起的監察措施。

en.q: Regarding a licence that expires while a valid renewal application awaits decision, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: If the application is still pending and the licence has not been revoked or suspended, the licence can continue beyond its old expiry date.
If the licensee withdraws the renewal application after the old expiry date, the pending-renewal protection continues until a refusal is issued.
If the licence is suspended while the renewal application remains pending, the application itself does not preserve the right to keep operating.
If renewal is granted after the old expiry date, its effective date is the day after the licence would otherwise have expired.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於有效續期申請待決期間到期的牌照，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 如申請仍待決，而且牌照未被撤銷或暫時吊銷，牌照可在原本屆滿日期之後繼續有效。
如持牌人在原屆滿日後撤回續期申請，待決續期的保障仍持續，直至關長發出拒絕決定。
如牌照在續期申請待決時被暫時吊銷，申請本身不能保留持牌人繼續經營的權利。
如原屆滿日之後才批給續期，續期生效日為沒有待決延續規定時牌照本應屆滿之日的翌日。

en.q: Regarding the start date of a condition imposed when a licence is granted, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: A grant-condition notice received on 4 June and specifying 8 June takes effect on 8 June rather than immediately on receipt.
A grant-condition notice received on 10 June but specifying 8 June makes the condition effective retrospectively from 8 June.
A grant-condition notice received and specifying effect on the same day starts on that day, without an added 21-day waiting period.
Posting a grant-condition notice on 1 June makes the condition effective that day even if receipt and the specified time are later.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於批給牌照時施加條件的生效日期，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 批給牌照的條件通知在6月4日收到、指明6月8日生效，條件在6月8日才生效。
批給牌照的條件通知在6月10日收到、指明6月8日生效，條件會追溯至6月8日生效。
批給牌照的條件通知在收到當天指明生效，條件當天生效，無須另等21日。
批給牌照的條件通知在6月1日寄出，即使接獲及指明時間較後，也在寄出當日生效。

en.q: Regarding new and existing occupants of domestic MSO premises, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: If a new occupant refuses written entry consent, the Commissioner may exercise the statutory revocation or suspension powers.
Consent from every original occupant protects the licence even if a newly arrived occupant refuses to give written consent.
One existing occupant withdrawing consent can trigger the power even if every other occupant maintains written consent.
A new occupant’s refusal automatically cancels the licence without a decision or an opportunity for the licensee to be heard.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於金錢服務住宅處所的新舊佔用人，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 如住宅處所的新佔用人拒絕書面進入同意，關長可行使法定撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照權力。
只要原有佔用人全部曾經同意，即使新入住佔用人拒絕書面同意，牌照也不受該理由影響。
即使其他佔用人全都保留書面同意，一名原有佔用人撤回同意也足以觸發有關權力。
新佔用人拒絕同意便會自動取消牌照，無須關長決定，也無須給持牌人陳詞機會。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第24條最終擁有人定義(c)段

en.q: Regarding whether an individual is an ultimate owner of a corporate licensee, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: An individual with exactly 25% of issued capital, no voting control and no ultimate management control fails the share-capital limb.
An individual controlling 30% of issued capital indirectly through a trust can qualify without holding those shares personally.
An individual controlling 30% of general-meeting voting rights can qualify despite holding no issued shares in the corporation.
An individual with ultimate management control can qualify even with no shares and no more than 25% of voting rights.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於個人是否屬法團的持牌人的最終擁有人，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 個人恰好持有25%已發行股本，沒有投票控制或最終管理控制，不符合股本比例的條件。
個人透過信託間接控制30%已發行股本，即使沒有以個人名義持股，也可符合定義。
個人控制成員大會30%投票權，即使沒有持有法團的已發行股份，也可符合定義。
個人具有最終管理控制，即使沒有股份且投票權不超過25%，也可符合最終擁有人定義。

en.q: Regarding closing one of several licensed premises, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: Closing only one licensed branch still requires the licensee to notify the Commissioner of the intention before its closure date.
Keeping the other licensed branch open allows the licensee to retain the unchanged licence instead of returning it for amendment.
The closure notice must state the intended closure date as well as the intention to stop operating at that particular premises.
After receiving the returned licence, the Commissioner removes relevant register particulars as soon as reasonably practicable.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於停止在多個持牌處所中的一個處所營業，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 只關閉其中一個持牌分店，仍須在停業日期前向關長具報停止在該處所營業的意向。
只要另一持牌分店仍繼續營業，持牌人便可保留未經修訂的牌照，無須交回作修訂。
停業通知除了表明停止在該特定處所經營的意向，也必須載明擬定的停業日期。
關長收到交回的牌照後，須在合理地切實可行的範圍內，盡快刪除登記冊的有關詳情。

en.q: Regarding facts relevant to fitness and propriety of an MSO applicant, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: A foreign conviction requiring a finding of dishonesty is a listed consideration even if it is not itself a money-laundering offence.
An individual subject to current bankruptcy proceedings is a listed consideration even before adjudication as an undischarged bankrupt.
A corporate applicant with an appointed receiver is a listed consideration only if the corporation has also entered liquidation.
The listed considerations prevent the Commissioner taking another relevant matter into account when judging fitness and propriety.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於判斷金錢服務申請人適當人選資格的事實，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 外地定罪必須涉及不誠實裁斷時，即使不是洗錢罪，也屬明列須顧及的事宜。
個人現為破產程序的標的，即使尚未被判為未獲解除破產的破產人，也屬明列考慮事宜。
法團申請人有接管人獲委任，只有在法團同時已進入清盤時，才屬明列的考慮事宜。
列明的考慮事宜，會阻止關長在判斷適當人選資格時，考慮其他有關的事項。

en.q: Regarding a disciplinary fine and a further daily penalty, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: If a remedial order gives a deadline, the further daily penalty can cover continuing failure after that deadline has passed.
A licensee given extra time to pay its monetary penalty may use that payment extension to postpone the separate remedial deadline.
An order imposing a monetary penalty can be accompanied by a public reprimand because the Commissioner may use more than one power.
The ordinary thirty-day payment period begins when the penalty order takes effect as a specified decision, not when an inspection starts.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於紀律罰款及進一步按日罰款，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 命令採取糾正行動如指明期限，進一步按日罰款可涵蓋在該期限之後持續沒有遵從命令的情況。
持牌人獲延長繳付罰款期限後，可用該繳款延期，順延另一項糾正行動的期限。
施加罰款的命令可同時附有公開譴責，因為關長可行使多於一項的紀律處分權力。
通常三十日繳款期由罰款命令作為指明決定生效時起計，而不是由視察開始時起計。

en.q: Regarding sharing confidential inspection information for professional advice, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: An MSO subject to an inspection requirement may disclose relevant information to a solicitor acting professionally to advise on the AMLO matter.
That professional-advice exception also permits posting the inspection information publicly to obtain informal advice from anyone online.
When the authority consents to a disclosure, it may impose appropriate conditions instead of granting unrestricted permission.
A recipient given the information under the advice exception is automatically free to pass it on because the first disclosure was lawful.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於為專業意見而披露保密視察資料，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 受視察要求規限的經營者，可向以專業身分就條例事宜提供意見的律師披露有關資料。
專業意見例外也准許在網上公開張貼視察資料，以向任何網民徵求非正式意見。
有關當局同意披露資料時，可施加其認為適當的條件，並非必須給予不受限制的准許。
資料收取人根據徵詢意見例外獲得資料後，只因首次披露合法，便自動可再向任何人披露。

en.q: Regarding occasional transactions by ordinary individual customers, with no simplified CDD available, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: An occasional cash exchange of exactly $120,000 meets the general transaction-value threshold for CDD before it is carried out.
An occasional wire transfer of exactly $8,000 meets the wire-transfer CDD threshold even though it is below $120,000.
Three cash-exchange operations of $40,000 appearing linked may be treated separately so that no operation meets the CDD threshold.
Two apparently linked wire-transfer operations of $4,000 each can meet the occasional wire-transfer threshold when taken together.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於普通個人客戶的非經常交易，並無簡化盡職審查可用，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 恰好120,000元的非經常現金兌換，符合一般交易金額門檻，須在進行前作盡職審查。
恰好8,000元的非經常電傳轉賬，即使少於120,000元，仍符合電傳轉賬盡職審查門檻。
三次看似有關連的40,000元現金兌換，可分開處理，令每次操作都不達盡職審查門檻。
兩次看似有關連的4,000元電傳轉賬操作，合併計算時可符合非經常電傳轉賬門檻。

en.q: Regarding small transactions accompanied by suspicion or identity doubts, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: A suspected laundering transaction of $1,000 can trigger CDD despite being below both the general and wire-transfer monetary thresholds.
If identification data previously obtained appears inadequate, CDD can be triggered even without evidence that the data is deliberately false.
Suspicion concerning the customer’s account can trigger CDD even where the MSO has not formed a separate suspicion about the customer personally.
Previously verified identity data that now appears untrue can trigger fresh CDD even though the MSO completed verification when the account opened.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於附有懷疑或身分疑問的小額交易，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 涉及洗錢懷疑的1,000元交易，即使低於一般及電傳轉賬金額門檻，也可觸發盡職審查。
過往取得的身分資料看似不充分時，即使沒有故意虛假資料的證據，也可觸發盡職審查。
對客戶戶口的懷疑，即使經營者沒有另行懷疑客戶本人，也可觸發盡職審查責任。
先前已核實的身分資料現時看似不真實，即使開戶時曾完成核實，也可再次觸發盡職審查。

en.q: Regarding a proposal to verify identity after opening a business relationship, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: Preventing interruption of normal business is insufficient by itself if the risk created by delayed verification is not effectively managed.
An MSO may delay verification merely for customer convenience even if delaying it is not necessary to avoid interrupting normal business.
Effective risk management alone allows delayed verification even when there is no need to avoid interrupting the customer’s normal business.
Once delayed verification is permitted, the MSO may leave it unfinished until the next periodic review even if earlier completion is practicable.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於在建立業務關係後才核實身分的建議，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 如延遲核實引起的風險未獲有效管理，單憑避免干擾正常業務的需要，並不足以延遲核實。
即使延遲核實並非為避免干擾正常業務所必需，經營者也可只為方便客戶而延遲核實。
即使無須避免干擾客戶的正常業務，只要風險獲有效管理，也一律准許延遲核實身分。
獲准延遲核實後，即使可更早完成，經營者也可留待下次定期覆核時才完成身分核實。

en.q: Regarding decisions when mandatory CDD cannot be completed, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: If required CDD cannot be completed before a new relationship, the MSO must decline to establish that relationship.
If required CDD for an occasional transfer fails, the MSO may execute the transfer first and restrict later transactions instead.
If permitted delayed verification cannot be completed, the MSO must end the existing relationship as soon as reasonably practicable.
If required CDD fails after a relationship already exists, closing the relationship is optional whenever the next transaction is small.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於未能完成強制盡職審查時的決定，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 如未能在新業務關係建立前完成所需盡職審查，經營者不得建立該業務關係。
如非經常轉賬所需盡職審查失敗，經營者可先執行該轉賬，改為限制其後交易。
如獲准延遲的核實無法完成，經營者須在合理地切實可行範圍內，盡快結束現有關係。
如已建立關係後所需盡職審查失敗，只要下次交易金額細小，結束關係便屬自願選擇。

en.q: Regarding an MSO starting an ordinary relationship with a qualifying listed company, with no suspicion or identity doubt, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: Reasonable grounds for believing that the company is listed can permit the MSO to use the statutory simplified CDD route.
Choosing simplified CDD permits the MSO to omit identification and verification of the listed corporate customer itself.
If a representative acts for the company, simplified CDD permits the MSO to accept that representative without checking authority.
The statutory listed-company category requires a Hong Kong listing, so listing solely on a foreign stock exchange cannot qualify.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於經營者與合資格上市公司建立普通關係，沒有懷疑或身分疑問，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 如有合理理由相信該公司已上市，經營者可採用法定簡化客戶盡職審查安排。
選用簡化盡職審查後，經營者可省略上市法團客戶本身的身分識別及核實。
如有人代表公司行事，簡化盡職審查准許經營者接受該代表，無須核實其授權。
法定上市公司類別要求在香港上市，因此只在外地證券市場上市並不足以符合資格。

en.q: Regarding an unlisted customer whose ownership chain includes a qualifying listed entity, without suspicion or identity doubts, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: The MSO may stop identifying or verifying beneficial owners of the qualifying listed entity and of persons further up that ownership chain.
The presence of the listed entity exempts every individual beneficial owner in the chain, including those below the listed entity.
The unlisted customer itself must become listed before the ownership-chain exception can apply to the qualifying listed entity above it.
A foreign-listed qualifying entity can provide the same stopping point because the listed-entity category is not confined to Hong Kong exchanges.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於非上市客戶的擁有權鏈含合資格上市實體，並無懷疑或身分疑問，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 經營者可不再識別或核實合資格上市實體及其上層人士的實益擁有人身分。
只要鏈中有上市實體，所有個人實益擁有人都獲豁免，包括位於上市實體以下的人士。
非上市客戶本身必須先行上市，才可對其上層的合資格上市實體使用擁有權鏈例外。
外地上市的合資格實體也可作為相同的停止追查層次，因上市類別不限於香港市場。

en.q: Regarding a representative opening an MSO relationship for a company with an obvious commercial purpose, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: When both purpose and intended nature are obvious, the specific duty to obtain information about them is subject to an exception.
The obvious-purpose exception also permits the MSO to dispense with checking the representative’s authority to act for the company.
A genuine identity document for the representative does not itself establish that the representative is authorized to act for the company.
Where the company has a beneficial owner, a clear business purpose does not remove the requirement to understand ownership and control.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於代表公司建立具有明顯商業目的的金錢服務業務關係，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 當目的及擬具有的性質均屬顯而易見時，取得有關目的及性質資料的特定責任設有例外。
目的顯而易見的例外，也准許經營者省略核實代表該公司行事的人的授權。
代表的身分證明文件即使真實，也不等於已核實該人獲授權代表公司行事。
公司有實益擁有人時，即使業務目的清楚，也不會取消了解公司擁有權及控制權結構的責任。

en.q: Regarding identifying the originator where someone else gives a wire-transfer instruction, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: If money is paid from a company’s account with the ordering MSO, its employee giving the instruction does not replace the company as originator.
If there is no such account, the person instructing the ordering institution to make the transfer is the originator under the definition.
If the originator has no account, the ordering MSO records a unique reference number that the beneficiary institution assigned to the transfer.
If the recipient lacks an account, the recipient-side replacement reference is assigned by the beneficiary institution, not the ordering MSO.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於由他人發出電傳轉賬指示時識別匯款人，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 如款項從公司在匯款經營者的戶口支付，發指示的僱員不會因此取代公司成為匯款人。
如沒有上述付款戶口，指示匯款機構進行該項轉賬的人便是定義所指的匯款人。
如匯款人沒有戶口，匯款經營者須記錄由收款機構為該轉賬編配的獨特參考編號。
如收款人沒有戶口，收款人一方的替代參考編號由收款機構編配，而非由匯款經營者編配。

en.q: Regarding an outward non-wire remittance of $8,000 whose originator presents a travel document, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: The originator’s identity must be verified by reference to the identification document before the MSO carries out the remittance.
The MSO must record both the travel document number and the place of issue, rather than recording the number alone.
The record must include when the instructions were received, including the date and time, rather than only when the money is delivered.
The MSO must also record the recipient’s name and address and the delivery method, although the transaction is not a wire transfer.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於匯款人出示旅行證件的8,000元非電傳香港以外匯款，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 經營者進行這項匯款之前，須藉參考匯款人的識別文件，核實匯款人的身分。
經營者須同時記錄旅行證件的號碼及發出地方，不能只記錄旅行證件號碼。
紀錄須載有接獲指示的日期及時間，而不只是金錢送遞時的日期及時間。
經營者也須記錄收款人的姓名及地址和送遞方式，即使這並不是電傳轉賬。

en.q: Regarding an MSO ordering an individual non-domestic wire transfer below $8,000, not bundled in a batch file, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: A $7,500 transfer does not require the extra originator address-or-alternative detail merely because its destination is outside Hong Kong.
The reduced information requirement removes the need to record the recipient’s name when the transfer is only $7,500.
The message for a $7,500 non-domestic transfer still carries the names and account or reference details of both sides.
Increasing that transfer to exactly $8,000 still leaves the extra originator detail optional because the exemption includes the threshold amount.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於經營者發出少於8,000元、並非集合在群組檔案內的單項非本地電傳轉賬，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 7,500元轉賬不會只因目的地在香港以外，而必須記錄匯款人的額外地址或替代資料。
轉賬只有7,500元時，簡減資料要求也令經營者無須記錄收款人的姓名或名稱。
7,500元非本地轉賬的信息，仍須附有雙方的姓名或名稱及戶口或參考編號資料。
把該轉賬增加至恰好8,000元後，額外匯款人資料仍屬可選，因為豁免包括門檻金額本身。

en.q: Regarding choosing a local intermediary for an MSO’s CDD, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: A second licensed MSO does not qualify under the listed local financial-institution intermediary category merely by holding its MSO licence.
An accounting professional can qualify under the professional route only if it satisfies the MSO that adequate AML/CFT procedures are in place.
A local estate agent is excluded from the professional intermediary route even where adequate AML/CFT procedures satisfy the MSO.
A licensed insurance broker company can be a listed financial-institution intermediary even though it is not an authorized bank.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於為金錢服務經營者選擇本地盡職審查中介人，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 另一持牌金錢服務經營者，不能單憑金錢服務牌照便符合明列的本地金融機構中介人類別。
會計專業人士必須令經營者信納已有充分防止洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集程序，才可走專業人士途徑。
即使其充分打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集程序令經營者信納，本地地產代理仍不能走專業中介人途徑。
持牌保險經紀公司即使不屬銀行業的認可機構，也可符合明列的金融機構中介人類別。

en.q: Regarding related foreign intermediaries used by a non-Hong Kong-incorporated MSO that has not re-domiciled, which statements are correct under the AMLO?
statements: Its head office abroad can meet the relationship limb if it carries on business similar to a listed intermediary financial institution’s business.
A branch of its foreign head office can also meet the relationship limb if the required business condition is met.
The group policy relied on must apply to both the MSO and the relevant related foreign financial institution.
A qualifying relationship with the head office removes the need to satisfy the separate group-policy and group-supervision conditions.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於沒有遷冊至香港的外地成立經營者使用相關外地中介人，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 香港以外總行如經營與明列中介人金融機構相類業務，可符合相關外地機構定義的關係條件。
其香港以外總行的分行如符合所需業務條件，也可符合相關外地機構定義的關係條件。
所依賴的集團政策必須同時適用於經營者及有關的相關外地金融機構。
與總行有合資格關係，便可免除另須符合的集團政策及集團層面監管條件。
